# datasintef_service_permission (Resource)

Grants a single permission on a service instance to a single principal (user, machine user or group). Non-authoritative: other grants on the service, such as the creator's admin grant, are left untouched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datasintef_grafana" "example" {
  datahub                     = "my-hub"
  service_alias               = "my-grafana"
  display_name                = "Test grafana service"
  description                 = "Test ordering grafana service"
  availability                = "internal"
  compute_resources           = 1
  storage_capacity            = 4
  research_project_id         = "123456789-0"
  service_data_classification = "SINTEF Business Confidential"
  plugins                     = []
}

# Grant a user read access to the Grafana instance.
resource "datasintef_service_permission" "reader" {
  service_id = datasintef_grafana.example.id
  principal  = "jane.doe@example.com"
  permission = "grafana.reader"
}

# Grant a machine user editor access until the end of the year.
resource "datasintef_service_permission" "ci_editor" {
  service_id = datasintef_grafana.example.id
  principal  = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  permission = "grafana.editor"
  expires_at = "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permission` (String) Permission to grant, prefixed by the service type, e.g. `grafana.reader`, `minio.editor` or `hubgateway.user`. Valid values: clickhouse.admin, clickhouse.metadataReader, edgegateway.admin, edgegateway.user, edgegateway.metadataReader, grafana.admin, grafana.editor, grafana.reader, grafana.metadataReader, hubgateway.admin, hubgateway.user, hubgateway.metadataReader, jupyterhub.admin, jupyterhub.editor, jupyterhub.metadataReader, minio.admin, minio.editor, minio.reader, minio.metadataReader, postgresql.admin, postgresql.editor, postgresql.metadataReader, rabbitmq.admin, rabbitmq.editor, rabbitmq.reader, rabbitmq.metadataReader, webapp.admin, webapp.editor, webapp.reader, webapp.metadataReader.
- `principal` (String) Principal to grant the permission to: a user email, or a principal ID (user, machine user, group, ...). dsn-api resolves emails to principal IDs; see `principal_id`.
- `service_id` (String) Identifier of the service instance (datahub:service_alias), e.g. `datasintef_grafana.example.id`.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Optional RFC 3339 timestamp at which the grant expires. Must be in the future. Once the grant has expired, dsn-api no longer reports it and Terraform will plan to recreate it.

### Read-Only

- `granted_at` (String) Timestamp the grant was (last) created.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the grant (service_id/principal/permission).
- `principal_id` (String) Principal ID the grant was stored under, as resolved by dsn-api.
- `principal_type` (String) Type of the principal (user, machine, azureAdGroup, externalUser, organizationEntity, workgroup, datahub).
